description: The known intra-corpus duplicate pair carried forward from Package 06, resolved here with an explicit decision.

evidence.note: Official site gives address Gwalchmai, Holyhead LL65 4RW; organiser is the Anglesey Agricultural Society (Cymdeithas Amaethyddol Môn); single showground description, no indication of a second site.

Companies House record for 'The Anglesey Agricultural Society', registered address Ty Glyn Williams, The Showground, Gwalchmai, Anglesey, Gwynedd LL65 4RW -- same postcode, same organisation, confirms a single 160-acre showground site owned by the Society.

decision.reasoning: Both records already share postcode LL65 4RW, operator (Anglesey Agricultural Society), official domain (angleseyshow.org.uk), locality (Gwalchmai), and Welsh alias (Maes Sioe Môn) per the brief. Independent research confirms a single 160-acre showground owned and run by the Anglesey Agricultural Society at that address, with no indication anywhere of a second physical site. 'Anglesey Showground' and 'The Anglesey Showground' are the same real-world venue referenced with and without the definite article -- a trivial naming variant, not two venues.

effect_on_confirmed_estate.note: Only one of the two rows is CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS, so the pair does not inflate the confirmed count regardless of the decision. The other is capacity-unverified and was never part of the 800.
